records.description: Under Zeleni Venac's busy central market in Belgrade there's a small underground public toilet that has appeared in more than one gay cruising guide. The descriptions place it below the market, near the car park, with another approach mentioned from Kamenička Street. A visitor posting on 5 March 2026 claimed an encounter there, though another visitor found nobody when arriving at about 10:00 on 29 March. Don't confuse this one with the public WC at the nearby bus terminus; comments suggest the two are sometimes mixed up, which may also explain conflicting reports about a fee. Market hours are roughly 06:00–19:00, but that is not confirmation of this restroom's opening times. Expect an ordinary public facility, not a gay club, and be mindful of staff, other users, consent and local rules. No trustworthy age range or guaranteed busy hour has been established.
records.tags: Urban, Public Restroom, Market, Cruising Reports
records.opening_notes: Market 06:00–19:00 according to operator; exact under-market WC opening and fee unconfirmed. Do not confuse with bus-terminus WC.
caveats: Reports conflicting as to entry fee and activity

records.description: This Belgrade cruising-directory entry points to the underground pedestrian passage connecting Nušićeva Street with the Dom omladine youth centre, close to Republic Square. Municipal records list a public WC at the Nušićeva Passage, so the physical location is plausible, but it's not clear that the guide's historical experiences refer to the exact facility currently operating. An older September 2024 commenter describes several encounters, whereas a January 2026 reply says only that it is a good location; it doesn't confirm a recent meeting. The city gives seasonal opening times for its public toilets, rather than all-night access. This busy passage is shared by ordinary pedestrians and shoppers. The best visiting period, any age mix and current cruising activity remain unverified.
blockers: Recent 2026 comment is not an actual encounter
records.address: Nušićeva pedestrian passage, near Dom omladine, Belgrade
records.tags: Urban Passage, Public Restroom, Historical Reports
records.opening_notes: Municipal Nušićeva WC reportedly 07:00–22:30 winter; 07:00–23:00 summer. Confirm posted opening times.

records.description: Punta Sabbioni's pine woodland and dunes near the coast north of Venice appear in both a gay cruising directory and an older Squirt entry. The location is described as being behind the dog-friendly beach, close to but not necessarily inside the Marina di Venezia campsite. It's an outdoor beach-and-forest setting, so weather, daylight, protected dunes and access rules matter much more than any supposed club timetable. The latest readable messages on the original cruising page were from August 2025 and mostly ask when others might visit; a more recent Squirt reply indicator doesn't reveal what the person actually said. There's no verified recent encounter, reliable peak period or typical age profile. Respect resort boundaries and wildlife protections, and don't mistake a directory's privacy rating for permission to use the dunes.
blockers: No readable visitor report within previous twelve months
Squirt latest-reply marker has no content
Exact lawful access and crowd/times unconfirmed

records.description: Parco delle Cascine stretches west from central Florence along the Arno and has a long cruising reputation. The accounts point to the Via della Catena side, paths near the river and the area around the Piramide, rather than the entire park. Men meet around the hedge-lined paths and move farther into the grounds, especially after dark when the weather is mild. Several posts on 16 May 2026 describe a lively evening crowd with locals and tourists and activity continuing towards 02:00–03:00; those are visitor claims, not guaranteed hours. The older guide also mentions occasional police vehicles, and the park is shared with joggers, families and other visitors. Stick to permitted paths, pay attention to lighting and security, and don't assume everyone here is looking to meet. The reports suggest a mixed crowd, but no dependable numerical age range is available.

records.opening_notes: Open park; May 2026 visitor accounts suggest evenings after sunset, sometimes until about 02:00–03:00. No guaranteed crowd.
caveats: Tourist/local mix reported, not demographic survey

records.description: San Donato is a neighbourhood park in Florence's Novoli district, rather than a secluded all-night cruising ground. A gay directory includes it as a possible meeting place, but there is little support for the more ambitious claims about late-night visits. One visitor in July 2025 said the gates closed around 20:30–21:00. Florence's municipality reported further restrictions and fenced paths during repair works in June 2026. Neither development confirms any recent cruising activity. If you're visiting the park for its green space, follow the currently posted access hours and avoid areas closed for works. As a cruising recommendation it lacks what matters most: a current firsthand report, an identifiable meeting section, reliable times and an idea of the crowd.
blockers: Park gates and pathways may close
Repair works and access changes in 2026

records.opening_notes: Historic visitor suggested closing around 20:30–21:00; repairs affected access in 2026. Follow posted hours.
